family.description: SAM35 is a family of fungal proteins found in the peripheral mitochondrial outer membrane. It is essential for cell viability. It forms a subunit of the SAM (sorting and assembly machinery) complex and is crucial for the assembly of the precursors of Tom40 and porin, the outer membrane beta-barrel proteins involved in mitochondrial biogenesis [[cite:PUB00074955],[cite:PUB00016442]]. SAM35 is required in order for the Sam50 subunit of the SAM complex to bind outer membrane substrate proteins [[cite:PUB00110449]].
family.name: SAM35, subunit of SAM coomplex
